page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7t.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It has no local storage, requiring network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

The x86_64 architecture processor includes 48 KB L1d cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 MB L3 cache. Supported instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512 Foundation, and AVX-512 Vector Neural Network Instructions, alongside hardware-accelerated cryptography features like AES, VAES, and SHA_NI. It lacks support for Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-VNNI.

Benchmark data places the instance in the average performance tier across most evaluated workloads. Single-core and multi-core CPU performance tests via stress-ng yielded scores of 1860.89 and 23311.6 respectively. Memory bandwidth tests showed 127.7 GB/sec for large block read-only operations and 63.99 GB/sec for large block write operations. Notably, LLM inference text generation using a small 135M model achieved a strong performance rating in the top 25% with 294.62 tokens per second, while larger 7B model text generation remained in the average tier at 13.1 tokens per second.

This instance class offers balanced resource density suitable for general-purpose workloads such as database operations, web serving, and software compilation. Passmark database operations scored 10486.69, and static web serving throughput reached 25.51 GB/sec. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and lack of bundled local storage or GPU hardware, the instance represents a standard mid-tier compute option where workloads rely on external storage and require predictable CPU performance without specialized acceleration.
